problem: For which values of $k$ does the series ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{{3}^{kn-2}}{{9}^{n-1}}$ converge?

feedback.problem: Which of the following statements is true regarding the series  ${\sum }_{n=3}^{\infty }\frac{2}{15}{(\frac{6}{5})}^{n-1}$ ?
feedback.worked_solution:
The series starts with $n=3.$ So the common ratio is

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =\frac{{a}_{4}}{{a}_{3}} \\  & =\frac{\frac{2}{15}{(\frac{6}{5})}^{4-1}}{\frac{2}{15}{(\frac{6}{5})}^{3-1}} \\  & =\frac{{(\frac{6}{5})}^{3}}{{(\frac{6}{5})}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{6}{5}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the series is divergent because $|r|\ge 1.$
